Batch: JoeWare ExchMbx, Expire and FindNBT publisher source review

Scope.AdFindAcceptance: Excluded from selected acceptance batches; no AdFind action in this review.

Findings: Publisher describes ExchMbx as an Exchange directory/mailbox enable, disable, move and attribute-management utility; page version 1.4.0 dated 2006-04-29.
Requires Exchange Tools on the host; publisher platform claims end at Windows XP / Server 2003, with Exchange 2007 explicitly untested.

Publisher warns batch use can make serious directory/mail changes; it calls out clear as capable of clearing mail objects across a forest and documents a default 10-object safety threshold with an -unsafe bypass.
Source code is unavailable per the page.

Sources.Finding: Usage includes create/move/mail-enable/clear/update and quota operations, batch input from stdin/files, and a default safety limit of 10 objects. No directory or Exchange endpoint was contacted.

Findings: Publisher describes Expire as flagging listed accounts to change their password at next logon; page version 1.00.0 dated 2000-04-15.
Consumes a tab-delimited account file and requires at least Account Operators on a domain or administrator on a member/standalone machine.
Publisher platform claims end at Windows XP; source code is unavailable.
Publisher describes FindNBT as scanning an IP address or range for Windows machines publishing NetBIOS names, with CSV/output-file options; page version 1.02.0 dated 2002-11-15.
Publisher platform claims end at Windows XP; no special privilege is listed and source code is unavailable.

Sources.Finding: Usage accepts a single address or start/end IP range and writes result files by default unless disabled. Future behavior checks must use an isolated synthetic network and disposable output path.

Findings: ExchMbx 01.04.00 dated 2006-04-29; publisher MD5 2f373a9c206f5a2794cfc693f604d9fe and SHA-1 8d07815581f07b2262a6ba2a213ba7eceff81c4e.
FindNBT 01.02.00 dated 2002-11-15; publisher MD5 3b8d3657b36aec0fb7a0bebc4d88f0c2 and SHA-1 a6139dc3a7f6d09e59a77c40977f2ea1f1e327de.
Sources.DigestBoundary: Publisher digest rows are observations, not locally verified archive hashes.

Resolved: Publisher product purpose, historical platform requirements and version-list rows for ExchMbx, Expire and FindNBT.
Deferred: Exact publisher archives, local SHA-256 and member inventory.
Inert package lifecycle/recovery and isolated behavior: disposable directory fixtures for ExchMbx/Expire; synthetic subnet and output fixture for FindNBT.
Windows 11 target support and current dependencies; historical claims do not establish it.

Estimate.Adjustment: Unchanged; source review does not establish bytes, lifecycle or current Windows behavior.
